stories.headline: Etched Raises $700 Million at a $21 Billion Valuation and Ships Its First Rack to Jane Street
stories.key_takeaway: Etched doubled its valuation to $21 billion in 26 days on a $700 million round led by Jane Street, which became the startup first customer after installing and testing its inference rack in production.

pull_quote.text: Inference is becoming one of the most important infrastructure markets in AI, and the winners will be measured by tokens per dollar and per watt.

stories.headline: Velaura AI Raises $110 Million and Becomes a Unicorn Betting That Power, Not Chips, Is AI's Next Bottleneck
stories.key_takeaway: Velaura AI's $110 million Series A at a $1 billion-plus valuation is a bet that as data center power becomes the binding constraint on AI growth, performance per watt is worth as much as raw compute.

pull_quote.text: The next era of AI will be defined not only by better models, but also by fundamentally better compute economics.

stories.headline: Google Bids $10 Million for Spirit Airlines' Internal Email Archive to Train Workplace AI
stories.key_takeaway: Google's $10 million bankruptcy-auction win for Spirit Airlines' internal communications archive establishes a court-sanctioned template for converting defunct companies' workplace data into AI training material, and a flight attendants union is fighting it.

pull_quote.text: This is outrageous! We are filing a court objection to Google's attempt to buy data that has no business being sold.
pull_quote.role: International President, Association of Flight Attendants-CWA

stories.article_excerpt: For 25 years, no major U.S. airline had simply switched off the lights and walked away. Spirit Airlines did.

stories.headline: Pony.ai Says Its Overseas Robotaxi Pipeline Now Tops 4,000 Vehicles
stories.key_takeaway: Pony.ai's overseas robotaxi commitments now exceed 4,000 vehicles, roughly double its entire current global fleet, anchored by a contracted 2,000-plus deployment with Uber across five European cities.

pull_quote.text: With this contract, we become Uber's largest autonomous driving partner in Europe. Going forward, as the performance and also the economics continue to validate at scale, we'll see substantial room to expand the fleet size even further.

stories.headline: Baidu's AI Cloud Growth Still Can't Outrun Its Collapsing Ad Business
stories.key_takeaway: Baidu's AI-powered business crossed 50% of core revenue for the first time, but it added only RMB 2.5 billion year over year while legacy advertising shed RMB 3.2 billion, leaving total revenue down 4%.

pull_quote.text: While our online marketing business remains under pressure, the growing momentum in our core AI-powered Business reaffirms Baidu's transition from an internet-centric company to an AI-first company.

stories.headline: MediaTek Expands Its Custom AI Chip Business as Hyperscalers Look Past Nvidia's GPUs
stories.key_takeaway: MediaTek is doubling down on custom AI ASICs, guiding to over $2 billion in 2026 data center revenue and a 15-20% share target of an $80 billion 2027 market, as hyperscalers unbundle the turnkey ASIC model.

pull_quote.text: The company has gained some traction recently in custom accelerators, like with Google. But, aiming for 15-20 percent seems very high at this point.

stories.headline: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT for Teens, Auto-Enrolling Users Its Age-Prediction Model Thinks Are Under 18
stories.key_takeaway: OpenAI is auto-enrolling anyone its behavioural age-prediction model flags as under 18 into a restricted ChatGPT experience, making inference-based age assurance the industry's new default just as the FTC and state legislatures close in.

pull_quote.text: There's no need for a teen to create a new account or change anything; if we predict you're under 18, or you've told us so, this becomes your default experience.

stories.headline: Reddit Starts Turning Its Text Archive Into AI-Narrated Video
stories.key_takeaway: Reddit is testing AI-narrated video versions of old text threads, a bid to stop leaking its archive's value to TikTok creators and AI labs and start monetizing it as higher-priced video inventory itself.

pull_quote.text: There's an emerging content type elsewhere on the internet of, basically, podcasts where people read Reddit content. I think this version of, like, listened-to or spoken Reddit can be really engaging, as well.

pull_quote.text: ES is an inference-only fine-tuning mechanism, where the model weights are never differentiated, only evaluated.

stories.headline: Cadence Says AI Agents Are Compressing Chip Design Timelines, and India Could Build the Next Semiconductor Startup Wave
stories.key_takeaway: Cadence says agentic AI is now automating enough of chip design and verification to compress tapeout schedules and lower the barrier to founding a fabless startup, a shift its verification chief argues could let India build a US-scale chip startup ecosystem within a decade.

pull_quote.text: The future will be a world where the productivity is another 10X compared to today. If we don't have agents, then we would need to hire 10 times the people because the semiconductor industry is growing so fast and the complexity is growing so fast.
pull_quote.role: SVP and GM, System Verification Group, Cadence Design Systems

pull_quote.text: Safety engineering has traditionally required every organization to recreate much of the same foundational work. We believe open source can change that.

stories.headline: Meta Goes to Trial Against 29 States Over Whether Algorithmic Design Itself Harms Teens
stories.key_takeaway: By suing over product architecture rather than user content, 29 states are testing a legal theory that would make engagement-optimizing algorithms themselves a design defect, a precedent reaching far beyond social media into every AI-driven product.

pull_quote.text: Meta's business model can be summed up in four simple words: hook the users, hold them for as long as they can, harvest their data, and then hide the truth from the public when making public statements.
pull_quote.role: Deputy Attorney General, State of California
